content: ध्वनिः [ध्वन्-इन्] .²1 Sound, echo, noise in general; मृदङ्गधीरध्वनिमन्वगच्छत् <ls>R. 16. 13</ls>, <ls n="R.">2. 72</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 72</ls>; <ls>U. 6. 17</ls>. शब्दो ध्वनिश्च वर्णश्च मृदङ्गादिभवो ध्वनिः <ls>Bhāṣā P.</ls>; स्फोटस्य ग्रहणे हेतुः प्राकृतो ध्वनिरिष्यते <ls>Vāk. P.</ls> .²2 Tune, note, tone; <ls>Śi. 6. 48</ls>. .²3 The sound of a musical instrument; पटुपटहध्वनिभिर्विनीतनिद्रः <ls>R. 9. 71</ls>. .²4 The roar or thunder of a cloud. .²5 A mere empty sound. .²6 A word. .²7 Hint, implied meaning. .²8 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) The first and best of the three main divisions of काव्य or poetry, in which the implied or {%suggested%} sense of a passage is more striking than the {%expressed%} sense; or where the {%expressed%} sense is made subordinate to the {%suggested%} sense; इदमुत्तममतिशयिनि व्यङ्ग्ये वाच्याद् ध्वनिर्बुधैः कथितः <ls>K. P. 1</ls> (<ls>R. G.</ls> gives 5 kinds of ध्वनि; see under ध्वनि).
